title: globifera reflexa
intro: Globifera reflexa, commonly known as the Reflexed Globe, is a plant species belonging to the family Asteraceae. It is used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Globifera reflexa include relieving pain, reducing inflammation, and supporting the immune system. Its bioactive constituents include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
